identity.name: Unpaywall
identity.description: Database of legal open-access copies of scholarly articles, keyed by DOI: for each DOI, the OA status and every known free-to-read location with version and licence.

asserted.rationale: The standard lawful-OA finder: it only lists copies hosted by publishers or repositories, with version and licence recorded. It says where a free copy is; the content's authority is the publisher's (or the repository's for AAMs). Tier 2 as an index.

jurisdiction.notes: Global literature; the pilot filters to US single-family housing at query time.

artifacts.notes: is_oa, oa_status (gold/hybrid/bronze/green/closed), best_oa_location {url, url_for_pdf, version, license, host_type}, oa_locations[].

content.notes: url_for_pdf is often a direct PDF; some point at a repository landing page (landing_then_file).

auth.notes: Not a secret key: Unpaywall requires a contact email on every call. It is referenced by name so Ellie's address never lands in a tracked file; the ref is deliberately unresolved until Ellie chooses which address to use.

limits.notes: Provider-documented 100,000 calls/day per email; above that use the data snapshot. Budget is provider_asserted.

endpoints.name: oa-by-doi
endpoints.description: OA status and legal free locations for one DOI.

params.name: doi
params.description: Bare DOI. The CLI URL-encodes the slash (%2F); untested against Unpaywall until the contact ref resolves.

response.notes: Single object; 404 when the DOI is unknown to Unpaywall; 422 when the email is missing or a placeholder.

verification.notes: Waiver: awaiting Ellie's choice of contact email (credential_ref scholarly_contact_email is intentionally unresolved; the API refuses calls without one). Probe once the ref resolves.

best_for: DOI -> lawful free full-text URL (PDF or landing page), with version and licence
Deciding whether a paper needs keyed or institutional access at all

query_shapes.recipe: doi=10.x/y; prefer best_oa_location with version publishedVersion; record version + license in the UPC source; fetch url_for_pdf through the page reader / pdf-harvest.

pitfalls: An acceptedVersion (AAM) or submittedVersion copy is not the version of record: page numbers and wording can differ; record the version and do not cite page numbers from it as if they were the journal's.
oa_status bronze (free on the publisher site, no licence) can disappear; capture the bytes when found.
license may be null even for a free copy; free-to-read is not free-to-redistribute.
OpenAlex's best_oa_location carries the same data in batch (50 DOIs per call); use Unpaywall for single lookups or when OpenAlex lacks the DOI.
The email is mandatory; a placeholder like test@example.com is rejected, and a real address must be Ellie's choice (credential_ref scholarly_contact_email).
guidance.llm_notes: Run before any institutional attempt: a lawful OA copy removes the need to touch UC Davis or Elsevier entitlements.

resolution.notes: Cite the published article (DOI); the OA location is only where the bytes were read. Record host_type (publisher/repository) and version in the UPC source.

lifecycle.cadence_notes: Data refreshed continuously from publisher and repository crawls.

relations.notes: Same operator; OpenAlex's open_access / best_oa_location fields are built from Unpaywall data.

discovery.discovered_via: model knowledge (Hermes scholarly registry pass), cross-checked against pdf-harvest references

completeness.notes: Covers Crossref DOIs; OA detection depends on crawl coverage of repositories.
